newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall further on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall further on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell further at the daily auctions of Bulgarian finance ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills on Friday, central bank figures show.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 0.82 and 4.68 percent, respectively, down from 0.84 and 4.79 percent at Thursday's auctions and Wednesday's 0.97 and 4.92 percent.
Bids were received for a total of 49.113 billion lev worth of T-bills. The one-week issue was oversubscribed and the four-week undersubscribed.
The ministry approved bids for a total of 44.843 billion levs of paper.
The issues were offered with par values of 12 billion levs and 45 billion levs, respectively, and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 12,000 million levs 45,000 million levs
Bids received 15,170 million levs 33,942.7 million levs
Avg price of bids 99.17 pct 95.53 pct
Bids approved 12,000 million levs 32,842.7 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 0.82 pct 4.68 pct
